statement: Yengo et al. 2022 has 14 height evaluations and no interval on any of them.
detail: PGP000382 / PMID 36224396: 14 Height rows, 0 with an interval. Multi-ancestry score PGS002802 European R² rounds to 0.40; its other ancestries round to 0.09–0.21.

statement: European R² 0.40 and other ancestries about 0.09–0.21 describe the multi-ancestry score, not every one of the 14 rows.
detail: PGS002802 (GIANT_HEIGHT_YENGO_2022_PGS_WEIGHTS_ALL, 1,103,042 variants, SBayesC) is the score evaluated in every ancestry group. These Catalog scores are not the 12,111-variant predictor in the reviewer's citation. The other 7 rows are ancestry-specific scores. 1 of those non-European rows fall outside 0.09–0.21 (lowest R² 0.033 on PGS002800 in South Asian).

statement: 630 score–trait pairs have a PGS R2 (no covariates) interval and both a European and a non-European evaluation, and they come from Tanigawa 2022 and Tanigawa 2023.
detail: 3150 evaluations, 630 score–trait pairs, PMIDs 35324888, 37890495. Each pair has 5 evaluations (2 European). Incremental R² is present on every row and has an interval on 0 rows. The full-model R² on the same rows does have an interval (3150/3150).

statement: The remaining named PGS R² values have no interval, so they cannot be meta-analyzed either.
detail: 1189 rows, all Tanigawa 2022 (PMID 35324888), all with case counts, all noting Nagelkerke's R². The interval in those rows is on the AUROC, not on the R².

statement: Within a trait there is usually only one score.
detail: Within each paper every trait has one score. Across the two papers, 586 of 608 traits have one score and 22 have two (the same trait released in both papers).

statement: These 630 pairs do not support a within-trait, multi-score meta-analysis.
detail: Each paper contributes one score per trait. All 630 European pairs are UK Biobank. 570 of 630 pairs label one European sample as a held-out testing cohort; the other European sample is a second UK Biobank partition. Non-European samples are one UK Biobank set per ancestry label.

statement: Under the named field 'PGS R2 (no covariates)', no other publication has a score–trait pair with an interval and both ancestries.
detail: Publications with that named field and an interval: Tanigawa Y 35324888; Tanigawa Y 37890495.

statement: The two Tanigawa papers are the only large cross-ancestry set with an R² interval.
detail: That sentence is true for the named field only. Monti R 2024 (PMID 38908374) has 177 score–trait pairs (15 traits, up to 13 scores in one trait).
